There are 2 types of systems for homes serviced by the grid. One that works only to generate electricity that is fed back onto the grid. The second does the same as the first but can also work in a grid down scenario to power specific circuits on a sub panel.

Since grid down incidents normally only last a few hours, most of the people likely chose to forgo the extra expense, assuming they were properly advised by their solar system installer as to the limitations of the system they purchased.
